lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Si8Bi4 (reduced formula NdSi2Bi) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Nd centers each coordinated by 9 neighbors, while Si centers adopt 8-neighbor environments (4 Bi and 4 Nd or 2 Bi, 2 Nd, and 4 Si). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts among Si-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
